newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eggs, water thrown at Juppe in Bordeaux.
newsitem.headline: Eggs, water thrown at Juppe in Bordeaux.

text.p: A group of youths threw eggs and water at French Prime Minister Alain Juppe as he was leaving a restaurant in a working class area of Bordeaux, the southwest France city of which he is mayor, eyewitnesses said.
Juppe had dined in the establishment with his wife and aides late on Friday and the youths were awaiting him, apparently informed that the unpopular French leader was inside.
Juppe was doused with water but not hit by eggs, witnesses said. No arrests were reported.
The incident took place a few hours after Culture Minister Philippe Douste-Blazy was stabbed and wounded by a knife-wielding mental patient in Lourdes, also in southwest France.
